properties.description: claim_region accepts a QUERY describing the region, alongside the existing seed+depth. The query is evaluated at read time, every time, so the claim still follows the design as it changes — the property the seed+depth rule was chosen for, and the reason an explicit stored node list is refused (dec:a-claim-may-need-a-list-rather-than-a-radius). Serves cross-cutting duties a radius cannot describe: an audit, a sweep over everything of one kind, cold-validating what another session recorded. Two questions are deliberately left to the build: which query language, and whether an unevaluable or empty query is refused at claim time or reported at read time. claim_report must be able to say which shape a claim used, or a reader cannot tell a narrow region from a query that stopped matching.
properties.name: A claim describes its region by a query, for work no radius can express
